narrative: US midterm election headlines and surging Eurozone inflation drive FX repricing — Eurozone CPI accelerating to 4.0% pummels ECB rate-cut expectations, lifting EUR/USD to 1.1266 despite a +135bp Fed-ECB carry gap. Broad USD pressure sends DXY -0.54% lower, supporting equities +0.36% while gold higher +2.81% breaches $4,051; VIX 18.3. USD/JPY drops to 158.26 where options align via strong put skew (25d RR −2.01). Focus turns to US ADP employment at 13:15 UTC and ISM Services PMI at 15:00 UTC.
